observableDefect.title: Cohort 1 has no executable observable contract for semantic-group coherence, so 'the group follows the tenant' is unverifiable and could regress silently.
observableDefect.measurement: No test in the tree asserts that the members of a semantic group read the same expressive axis channels. The census script that produced the defect evidence is ad hoc and not a gate.
observableDefect.consequence: Without a gate, a later family edit can drop a group channel and nothing fails. The R1 objective 'extract reusable semantic group recipes instead of copying styles' would be provable once and then decay.

standardControlsUsed: existing playwright visual probe harness for captures at 320/390/768/1440
proControlsAndRecipesUsed: A group-coherence assertion that reads the group membership from the group stylesheets themselves and fails when a declared member stops reading a declared group channel — so the gate is derived from the contract, never from a hand-listed snapshot.
responsiveStrategy: Captures are taken at the four mandated widths for both tenants on every Cohort 1 scene; the taxonomy records overlap, clipping, per-character wrap and desktop compression as binary findings rather than as impressions.
mobileSimplification: The 320 and 390 captures are judged against the mobile law for each tenant direction (BitHire: simplified destinations, no squeezed desktop sidebar; The Management: single-column working dossier, square sheets, no miniature desktop grid).
statesAndMotion: State coverage is asserted per group member: rest, hover, focus-visible, press, disabled, loading. Reduced-motion is asserted to reach the settled state with no interpolation.
i18nRtlA11y: RTL is captured for at least one scene per group using real Arabic strings; contrast floors are asserted for ink-on-ground pairs in both tenants; forced-colors fallback is asserted to reach a solid ground.

expectedTenantDivergence.law: evidence lane does not author divergence; it measures it
expectedTenantDivergence.requirement: >=8 axes with >=6 non-colour, measured from the compiled artifacts of both tenants rather than asserted in prose
expectedTenantDivergence.recognitionProof: grayscale and primary-hue-neutralised captures must remain tenant-identifiable

honestStatus: IN_PROGRESS — packet submitted for admission before any evidence write. The defect census exists as data; the gate that keeps it true does not exist yet.
